address: 029 Lot H, Ngo Gia Tu Apartment, Su Van Hanh Street, Ward 2, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: Its famous beef stew known as bò kho is served in a stone bowl. Diners may choose to pair it with bread, noodles or rice. The broth is sweet and tasty, with a robust meaty flavour. Help yourself to condiments and sauces....
